Work Schedule (with Time Clock): plan who works which days and hours ahead of time, fill a week for several people, copy last week, mark someone leaving early; 'Working today' on the home page and as a TV display view.
Sick Leave: leave types can be renamed, turned off (e.g. FMLA) or added.
